entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-02-02
entry.content:
Issues

  • Where are parameters for csproj like fuse-ld with lld and no-gc-setcion? #52793

  • Replace `dotnetup` App Insights connection key with official SDK CLI telemetry endpoint #52785

  • File license header is not enforced in all source code #52775

  • Help output for `dotnet build` appears misleading #52770
  • MSBuildWorkloadSdkResolver intermittently fails for custom MSBuildSdk package from local source #52765
  • .NET SDK 10.0.102 creates bin directories with literal backslash characters on MacOS #52764
